stories.title: Create the npm workspace and pinned toolchain
acceptance: npm workspaces exist for apps/server, apps/web, packages/contracts, packages/simulation, packages/database, packages/config, packages/observability, packages/testing
Node 24 and exact direct versions from TASK-001 are pinned
root scripts include format:check, lint, typecheck, test, build and check
npm install produces a committed package-lock.json
npm run check passes from a clean install

stories.title: Enforce strict TypeScript references and Zod inference
acceptance: strict shared TypeScript settings and project references compile on TypeScript 7
each workspace has an explicit package export map
contracts contains a Zod schema with an inferred exported TypeScript type and executable test
format, lint, typecheck, test and build all pass

stories.title: Add executable simulation-boundary checks
acceptance: checker rejects web, database, telemetry, config, environment, filesystem, process, wall-clock and Math.random imports/usages in packages/simulation
a negative fixture is rejected for the intended rule only
npm run check includes the positive boundary check and all gates pass
stories.verify: npm run test:boundaries && npm run check

stories.title: Add Node 24 CI and fresh-clone evidence
acceptance: CI uses Node 24, npm ci, documentation checks and npm run check
workflow has read-only permissions and a bounded timeout
TASK-001 evidence records observed fresh-install and full-check output
working tree is clean after one story commit
stories.verify: npm ci && node scripts/check-docs.mjs && npm run check
